title: Three Major Challenges of Hydrogen Vehicles
subtitle: Cost to buy, access to refuel, and cost to run

purchase.title: High Vehicle Purchase Cost
purchase.multipleLabel: vs comparable ICE or BEV models
purchase.support: Vehicle prices start at approximately 300,000 RMB, around 1.5–4 times comparable ICE or BEV alternatives in the supplied reference.
purchase.scope: Reported price gap; it varies by vehicle segment.
purchase.alt: White and blue hydrogen fuel-cell sedan, concept render

refueling.title: Limited Hydrogen Refueling Accessibility
refueling.support: Most stations in the supplied reference use 35 MPa systems for commercial applications, while 70 MPa refueling remains limited, particularly outside major urban areas.
refueling.scope: Pressure levels are refueling standards, not vehicle performance ratings.
refueling.alt: Hydrogen refueling station with a canopy, dispenser and hose, and on-site hydrogen equipment

operating.title: High Operating Cost
operating.comparison: Higher cost per 100 km than a home-charged BEV under the stated comparison
operating.support: An average retail hydrogen price of 44.5 RMB/kg contributes to higher cost per 100 km than home-charged battery-electric vehicles under the stated comparison conditions.
operating.scope: No cost-per-100-km figure is available in the briefing material.
operating.alt: Frosted hydrogen refueling nozzle connected to a fuel-cell car
